images.prompt: Use case product-mockup. Make ONE square photorealistic industrial B2B catalogue photograph of a fitted passive round steel drum insulation cover. Design: one dark navy-blue cylindrical closed-head steel industrial drum on the floor, proportions height about 1.5 times diameter, the drum is only a prop. Flexible silver reflective laminate sleeve follows the entire round cylindrical side from just below the top rim to slightly above the bottom rolled chime, navy blue narrow base rim remains visible. One straight black bound vertical overlapping seam on the front, secured by exactly two SHORT horizontal black hook-and-loop tabs across that seam, each tab about a hand width and well separated vertically. No circumferential bands. A separate circular silver insulated cap fits on top, flat circular top with thin flexible silver skirt and fine black bound hem, covering the drum's steel top completely. No handles anywhere. No electric wire, electronics, heater, tubing, no cage, no pallet, no text. Real reflective foil shallow crinkles and fine slightly pebbled metal surface, not mirror, quilt, cloth, stitched diamonds or heavy padding. Camera slightly elevated three-quarter view, entire item centered, 12 percent margin on all sides, object occupies ~76% height. Clean seamless #F6F6F4 studio floor and backdrop, gentle real contact shadow, soft neutral daylight, ordinary accurate product photography. The two parts are a cylindrical side wrap plus a distinct low circular lid; simple manufacturable edge binding. No extra objects, watermarks, branding or measurement markings.
images.visualReview: Fitted circular cap, two closure tabs, free blue base rim.
